blocks: Saved export: read from the device's slot 29 over USB on October 25, 2026 with mise run microfreak:download --slot 29. Two consecutive reads returned the same file.

The parameter payload matches the MIDI Control Center archives Factory 1.0, Factory 1.1, Factory 2.1, Factory 3.0, Factory 6.0 (Factory 1.0 slot 105, Factory 1.1 slot 105, Factory 2.1 slot 117, Factory 3.0 slot 117, Factory 6.0 slot 431). Comparison used mise run microfreak:compare.
Download the slot 29 capture. It is the raw device format (header plus data packets), not an .mbp file; see Microfreak/Preset/029 Number Station/Asset/Device-Read-2026-10-25/bin.
